capabilities: Render title lists as cover galleries
Fetch covers and details from public sources
Preview covers with descriptions and links
Group covers by genre, decade or creator
Search, rate, mark and add entries
extras: No account or API key required; optional free TMDB key; needs internet for covers; caches details for 30 days.
problem: Plain title lists in notes have no visual overview, so users cannot browse covers or media details at a glance.

relations.evidence: Albums are looked up on both Wikipedia and Apple Music
openlibrary.org and covers.openlibrary.org for books only
If you add a free TMDB API key, film and TV posters can come from The Movie Database
Genre and creator come from Wikidata and are cached.

summary: Renderer that turns lists of movies, TV, books, games and albums into cover galleries with previews, grouping, search, ratings and checkmarks.
